title: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic's Amodei made $18 million last year, middle of the tech CEO pack
key_facts: Dario Amodei made $18 million in 2025 per Anthropic's S-1 prospectus, a copy of which Reuters obtained.
Dario and Daniela Amodei each earned $1.4 million in salary after it was doubled last July; Daniela earned $16.4 million in total.
The rest of the pay came as stock and option awards.
Equilar's Courtney Yu: $18 million seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion.
The S-1 did not detail how many shares the cofounders hold or their value.
The Amodeis and cofounders said they will commit 80% of their personal Anthropic equity to charity.
quote_evidence: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei made $18 million last year – placing among the tech world’s highest-paid executives ahead of the Claude chatbot maker’s planned IPO later this year.
The company’s S-1 prospectus did not detail how many shares they currently own or the value of those shares.
why_it_matters_hint: Amodei's $18M 2025 pay from the S-1, mostly equity.
notes: Reuters page blocked; read the New York Post's account of the Reuters exclusive. The $2 trillion valuation is from the Post's text ('expected to fetch'), not confirmed by us.
